</row>

<row gap="medium">

---

This terrifying mask is crafted in the visage of a leering demon and grants a +1 item bonus to Intimidation checks.

**Activate** <actions string="Two Actions" /> Interact;  **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** The mask casts a [_fear_](/Spells.aspx?ID=110) spell with a DC of 20.
